description: This file implements the Waves ripple effect library, providing functions to initialize, attach, and manage ripple effects on DOM elements, including event handling and visual effects.

methods.name: Waves.init
methods.description: Initializes the ripple effect on the document body, setting up event listeners for touch and mouse events.

methods.name: Waves.attach
methods.description: Attaches ripple effects to specified elements, adding necessary classes and wrappers.

methods.name: Waves.ripple
methods.description: Programmatically triggers a ripple effect on specified elements.

methods.name: Waves.calm
methods.description: Removes all ripple effects from specified elements.

methods.name: Waves.displayEffect
methods.description: Deprecated method to initialize effects, now replaced by Waves.init.
